_note: Labels for the admin area. The figures on it (commits, pages, photos, checks, tasks) are read from the repository when the site is built.
title: Admin: Lee-Elle Horowitz: private Hebrew tuition
desc: The admin area of Lee-Elle Horowitz's site: status, tasks, designs, content, photos, quality, activity and agents.
lead: Everything about this site in one place: what is live, what is waiting on whom, where every word and photo comes from, and every change. It is built from the repository each time the site is built.
status: English and Hebrew (translation not yet checked by her)
board_intro: Every task is a Markdown file in the repository's issues/ folder; the folder is the column. To move a card, move its file (for example git mv issues/open/005-approve.md issues/done/) and rebuild.
content_intro: Every word on the site lives in these JSON files. The pages are built from them by tools/designs/build.py; edit a file, rebuild, and every page that uses it changes.
pages_intro: Every page of the site, with its size.
photos_intro: Every image on the site, with its size and credit.
quality_intro: The checks that run before every push (bash tools/check.sh) and the extra ones the keeper runs.
checks: Build, link previews and internal links
Every design page under 8,000 px on a phone
No em dashes; leak scan for secrets
Hebrew on a real iPhone, Android phone and Windows
activity_intro: Every change to the site, newest first. Each is signed by the agent that made it.
agents_intro: The agents that work on this site, each with its own signing key.
made:
The site began as one request in the Sovereign Website factory on 25 November 2026, from the text Lee-Elle supplied. sites.b filed it and started a dedicated keeper; factory.b created this repository and its address; design.b wrote the design brief; the keeper built five designs, in English and in Hebrew; design.b.rounds reviewed them with synthetic parents, twice.

For the full story, see the behind-the-scenes tour, the keeper's notes and the publishing runs.
photo_rows: Share card: made by the keeper from the portrait above and her words.
tour: Prefer a walk through? See the guided tour, as slides or PDF.
